decisions.reason: As a close-to-core camera with its own product page in a growing space-electronics market, it still looks like a valuable option whose uncertainty has not yet resolved enough to justify withdrawal.
A modular camera line with several models signals broader commitment and reuse potential, so the firm is likely to keep investing while market acceptance and mission opportunities continue to unfold.

The sensor suite builds on existing capabilities but is somewhat more exploratory than the core camera offer, so it carries more uncertainty yet still enough strategic option value to remain on the market.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR appears less established because it was only mentioned on the website, but for a large R&D-intensive space supplier the cost of keeping this adjacent option alive is still likely below its potential future value.
